dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the mid-dorsal region; the largest exhibits a jagged charcoal-colored perimeter transitioning to a significantly lighter grey interior. Secondary 'C' structures are located posterior to the primary annulus with similar high-contrast gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity (dark charcoal) solid pixel clusters concentrated in the cervical and anterior-dorsal regions; density decreases posteriorly where clusters transition into structured annuli. Solid high-intensity (white/light grey) blobs are scarce and primarily localized within the centers of annular rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse, scalene triangle. The relative distance between the primary anterior annulus and the secondary posterior-dorsal annulus is approximately double the distance between the secondary and tertiary lateral-ventral annuli.

other_distinctive_markers: Linear occlusion by multiple vertical straw-colored elements across the mid-section and facial region creates vertical negative-space segments in the texture map.
